title.zh: 删除镜像仓库命名空间

descriptions.zh: > 删除镜像仓库命名空间会将存在于该命名空间下的所有仓库以及所有仓库下的镜像一并删除。
descriptions.en: > After you delete a namespace, all repositories in the namespace and all images in these repositories are deleted as well.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr delete-namespace --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --namespace-name ns3 --region cn-hangzhou
